files.bankruptcy_panel.csv: Firm-month modelling panel. One row per firm and month-end.
files.edgar_event_inventory.csv: All bankruptcy event rows available in the local SEC-derived bankruptcy label table, with coverage path through price checks and panel inclusion.
files.firm_label_coverage.csv: Per-firm observations and 12-month label coverage for firms present in the modelling panel.
files.audit.json: Machine-readable counts, input hashes, consistency checks, origin, and limitations.
files.README.md: Human-readable data dictionary and construction notes.

origin.event_source: Repository SEC-derived event table. The upstream edgar_labels.py describes SEC submissions bulk data (submissions.zip) and companyfacts bulk data (companyfacts.zip).
origin.event_rule: First SEC 8-K or 8-K/A with Item 1.03 (Bankruptcy or Receivership), beginning 2010; bankruptcy_date uses reportDate when not after filingDate, otherwise filingDate.
origin.feature_source: Previously generated panel.csv; point-in-time firm data assembled by data.py and build_panel.py from SEC fundamentals/shares, Yahoo Finance prices, and FRED DGS1 rates.

target.meaning: 1 when the first SEC Item 1.03 event date is after the observation date and no more than 12 calendar months later; otherwise 0.
target.censoring: Panel observations end 2024-12-30. The event inventory extends later; events more than 12 months after a firm's final panel observation do not create positive rows in this extract.

known_limitations: Controls were sampled from the current SEC ticker list and are survivor-selected by construction.

The original control draw excluded only the fundamentals-covered bankruptcy subset. This builder cross-checks every sampled firm against the full EDGAR event table, corrects the event flag, and removes observations on/after known events.
Panel construction requires a usable historical ticker and market-price history; many SEC bankruptcy events are therefore absent from the modelling panel.
Source panel ends before current label artifacts; events after its observation range cannot contribute positive rows.
Raw SEC bulk archives are not present in the repository, so the source artifacts cannot be independently rebuilt from this checkout alone.
